title: Private key block header in source
description: A PEM private-key header was found in source. Private-key material must never live in version control: anyone with repository access obtains the key, and rotation becomes impossible without a history rewrite.
remediation: Remove the key file from the source snapshot and from version control entirely (including history where applicable). Move private keys to a secret manager, load them at runtime, and rotate the exposed key. This detection does not prove the key is valid or in use.
limitation: Matches PEM-style private-key headers (RSA/EC/OPENSSH/generic) only. Certificates, public keys, single-line non-PEM keys, and encrypted keystores do not match. The header carries no key material; evidence is the header alone.
